caption: MCP Create Message Request Params
description: Parameters for a `sampling/createMessage` request. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 CreateMessageRequestParams; 2026-07-28 CreateMessageRequestParams).
name: mcp_create_message_request_params

mcp_create_message_request_params__meta.description: MCP member `_meta`: See [General fields: `_meta`](/specification/2025-11-25/basic/index#meta) for notes on `_meta` usage.

mcp_include_context.description:
MCP member `includeContext`: A request to include context from one or more MCP servers (including the caller), to be attached to the prompt.
The client MAY ignore this request.

Default is "none". Values "thisServer" and "allServers" are soft-deprecated. Servers SHOULD only use these values if the client
declares ClientCapabilities.sampling.context. These values may be removed in future spec releases.

mcp_max_tokens.description:
MCP member `maxTokens` (required by the protocol): The requested maximum number of tokens to sample (to prevent runaway completions).

The client MAY choose to sample fewer tokens than the requested maximum.

mcp_metadata.description: MCP member `metadata`: Optional metadata to pass through to the LLM provider. The format of this metadata is provider-specific.

mcp_model_preferences.description: MCP member `modelPreferences`: The server's preferences for which model to select. The client MAY ignore these preferences.

mcp_system_prompt.description: MCP member `systemPrompt`: An optional system prompt the server wants to use for sampling. The client MAY modify or omit this prompt.

mcp_task_metadata.description:
MCP member `task`: If specified, the caller is requesting task-augmented execution for this request.
The request will return a CreateTaskResult immediately, and the actual result can be
retrieved later via tasks/result.

Task augmentation is subject to capability negotiation - receivers MUST declare support
for task augmentation of specific request types in their capabilities.

mcp_tool_choice.description:
MCP member `toolChoice`: Controls how the model uses tools.
The client MUST return an error if this field is provided but ClientCapabilities.sampling.tools is not declared.
Default is `{ mode: "auto" }`.

mcp_tool_list.description:
MCP member `tools`: Tools that the model may use during generation.
The client MUST return an error if this field is provided but ClientCapabilities.sampling.tools is not declared.

mcp_additional_members.description: Members the pinned definition does not name, exactly as reported, in source order.

mcp_nonconforming_members.description: Named members whose value does not fit the pinned definition, exactly as reported.
